# Free Press As a [bold]Free Press[/bold] editor you answer faxes from the Free Press Offices in the Zypheron Sector. Your main contact is the [bold]Correspondent[/bold] aboard the [italic]Almayer[/italic].
Everything on the [textlink="Fax Responders" link="RMCRulesFaxResponder"] page still applies. This page only covers what is specific to the Free Press.
[bold][color=#ff6b6b]Free Press rules[/color][/bold] - You may [bold]not[/bold] give objectives that break Marine Law, such as stealing items or classified documents. - Keep it professional. - You are free to write articles from a correspondent's info and fax them aboard the [italic]Almayer[/italic], but [bold]only[/bold] if the correspondent agrees to it. - You may ring correspondents to gain info, as they are often away from the fax machine. - You must report anything antagonistic to the admins via AHELP, and thereafter to the MPs.
## Your Character You are the editor of a paper, armed with a trusty TV to watch correspondent cameras. You are free to contact correspondents via their radio pack or their phone, as they are a lot more active in the round and not often near their fax machine.
As on the [textlink="Weston-Yamada" link="RMCRulesFaxResponderWeYa"] page and the main rules, you are mostly concerned with bouncing off what the correspondents are planning to do, or, if they seem directionless, giving them something to build on.
The only thing you strictly have to gain is [bold]information[/bold], and objectives should revolve around it.
There is arguably more room for creativity in how you write articles, if the correspondents agree to that dynamic. If you go down that route, feel free to play around a bit more with how your articles look. Fax replies should still use the reply template in your bag.
## Fax / Communication Ideas - Have the Correspondent investigate rumors of colonial instability or corporate negligence. - Have them document survivors' living conditions or morale. - Perhaps show a little bias towards either We-Ya or the UNMC. - Request a feature story about anything that's happened in the round. - Have them run "Man on the Street" interviews with low-ranking marines about the battle.
## Your Equipment - [bold]Reply template:[/bold] a pre-formatted Free Press fax in your satchel. Base every reply on it so all Free Press faxes look the same. - [bold]Stamp:[/bold] the Free Press stamp is what makes a fax authentic. Stamp every reply.
